meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 技能启用后，Claude 会进入 HYPERPLAN 模式，组建 5 名评审成员互相攻击对方方案；只保留经受住攻击的结论，再强制交给规划任务形成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等触发词，或提出需要最严格审视、要暴露薄弱假设/盲点/过度设计的规划请求时，会切入该模式。

say.text: hyperplan：为产品新功能做一份可执行计划。
say.note: 会进入该模式并组织 5 人对抗性评审。

say.text: hpp：对迁移方案做交叉批判，暴露隐藏的断点与盲点。
say.note: 各评审成员会互相攻击方案的薄弱处。

say.text: adversarial plan：攻击这份计划，揪出没有依据的假设。
say.note: 只有经受住攻击的结论进入正式计划。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude enters HYPERPLAN mode, builds a five-member hostile review team to cross-critique the plan, keeps only the insights that survive, and passes them to a planner task to make an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or ask for planning with maximum rigor to surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: hyperplan: make an executable plan for this new feature.
say_en.note: Starts HYPERPLAN mode and the 5-agent review.

say_en.text: hpp: cross-critique the migration plan to expose blind spots.
say_en.note: Team members attack each other's weak points.

say_en.text: adversarial plan: attack this plan and flag ungrounded assumptions.
say_en.note: Only surviving insights go to the planner.
